consultation.idea: Level 1 Exploration for Abbie’s World carwash: visually busy wash studio, simple calm job. Articulated robotic apparatus follows cursor or finger immediately. Rinse, soap, scrub the top and sides, pressure wash tires, rinse, wax, dry. Every run starts super filthy. Partial work always earns a score, no combos or timer pressure. Decoration-pack progress belongs to whichever vehicle enters. Small car diagram selects parts in 0.25 seconds; whole, part and close zoom. Crayola Scribble Scrubbie wash-station reference. Optional story event: thief robs wash, choose to call police and chase, preserve wash on return. Study only, not game-ready.

consultation.fantasy: You are an upstart boss who grows a tiny farm into a region-spanning logistics empire, one route and one district at a time.

rules.rule: Ranch supply chains: fields and animals produce raw goods (wheat, milk, wool, apples), workshops turn them into products (bread, cheese, yarn, pies), carts carry them along roads to a market stall or the station.
Bottlenecks are the puzzle: barns and carts have capacity, so a child sees goods pile up and fixes it by building another cart or a bigger barn.
Two kinds of reward: coins from selling, and 'thank-you stars' from neighbours you deliver to. Stars unlock new building types; coins build them.
Expansion by valleys: helping a neighbouring valley (delivering what it asks for) opens its land, new crops and a new road.
Gentle pressure instead of raids: the weather and the seasons (a rainy week floods a road, winter slows fields), so players spread out and plan ahead. Nothing is lost; things just slow down.
Ranch hands with traits (fast, careful, loves animals) run a building or a cart; one can be put in charge of a valley.
